text:
michelle_devex: Heads-up — changelog freeze in ~18h. I'm creating the release branch now. Need owners for: SDK packaging, quickstart/docs publish, and sampleapp smoke runs. pinging folks for ownership and any blockers.

sam_engineering: I'll own SDK packaging. I'll open the release PR, tag the artifact and bump the package version. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

jordan_docs: I can own quickstarts/docs publish. Please hand me final code snippets from @sam_engineering by noon tomorrow. Also, do we have a one-liner for the batching fix for the changelog?

lee_pm: I'll coordinate the release checklist during the freeze window. Top priorities: sampleapps smoke and changelog completeness.

ana_qa: I can run the sampleapp smoke tests. Need an env with API_KEY + staged model and the SDK artifact. @michelle_devex can you confirm test credentials will be available?

michelle_devex: Yes — creating an ephemeral test key and will post in #help once ready. Creating branch now: `git checkout -b rel/devex-0.9.1` and will push shortly. Anyone blocking?

olivia_sre: No infra blockers from SRE. FYI CI runner capacity is limited to 2 concurrent smoke jobs during the window — please stagger test runs.

sam_engineering: Noted. I'll upload the build artifact to CI with `make release-artifact && gsutil cp` and share the link here when done.

jordan_docs: Docs PR #412 is ready but needs signoff from @sam_engineering for snippet accuracy. Left TODOs for versioned path updates.

pedro_infra: I'll add an automated smoke job into the pipeline: `jobs/smoke-sampleapps.yml` with a matrix for node/python. Will trigger after SDK artifact is uploaded.

ana_qa: Plan: run quickstart end-to-end on macOS and linux containers, plus basic perf sanity. Will queue once artifact + creds posted.

michelle_devex: Changelog collection: paste final PR links and 1-line descriptions here. I'll aggregate into release notes and the CHANGELOG.md.

sam_engineering: PRs to include: #789 batching fix, #790 build tweaks. One-liners: "Improve batching heuristics for short requests" and "Fix docker build cache issue".

jordan_docs: Adding those now. Also adding a breaking-note for deprecated v1 config. @lee_pm should we surface migration guidance in the release notes?

lee_pm: Yes — include migration snippet: ```config.v1.enabled=false``` and link to the migration guide from the release notes.

michelle_devex: Blocker: ana_qa hit OOM when packaging sampleapp-ml locally — CI job failed on CPU. @pedro_infra can we bump that job to 8G?

pedro_infra: Yup, I'll bump memory for that specific job to 8G. Requeue when ready.

ana_qa: Re-ran after bump. Node sampleapp smoke passed; python sample failed with 401 auth to the staged endpoint — looks like the test key wasn't rotated in staging. @michelle_devex

michelle_devex: Rotating token now, will post new creds in #help and DM testers. ETA ~10m.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: release branch rel/devex-0.9.1 created by michelle_devex. CI queued 6 jobs.

ana_qa: All smoke jobs green after token fix. :tada: Moving checklist status to "ready for cut".

lee_pm: If no other blockers, I'll mark the changelog frozen at 11:59pm PT tonight. @everyone please confirm ASAP.

sam_engineering: :thumbsup: confirmed from SDK side.

jordan_docs: :thumbsup: docs ready — will merge on green.

michelle_devex: Thanks all. I'll perform the publish run after midnight PT if CI stays green. Keep an eye on release-monitor and flag anything odd.
